title: Print Single Spacing Unit
description: Refactor print LaTeX chrome/typography to use exactly one spacing unit everywhere (mirroring ui --ui-spacing/--spacing-single/--spacing-double). Fix dead-padding bug in window tab captions. Replace touch spacing and hardcoded 3pt with unit multiples.
summary: Fixed regression where window name, hierarchy label, top borders and tab backgrounds disappeared. Restored git-HEAD cap/gap/header geometry (`\vbox to \semio@chrome@titlebar@height`, `\vfil` centering, fixed titlebar height strokes). Removed broken dynamic row-height compute and plain `\vbox` cap structure. Spacing-only changes retained: `\hspace{\semio@chrome@padding}` in cap slots, tight tab/ctrl baselineskip, tcolorbox `top=\semio@chrome@padding` + `boxsep=0pt` + `before upper` parindent reset, `\noindent` before window bodies, navbar/footer chip padding via `\semio@chrome@padding`, headsep/footskip via `\semio@spacing@double`. All 12 template PDFs build; zwischenbericht page 3 verified visually — U-cutout header intact.
